decisions.reason: It maintains a page of its own and builds on the established offer, indicating results meet aspirations and no problemistic search is triggered.
Reduction to a mere mention signals performance below aspirations, and since it is close to existing offers rather than enabling new uses, problemistic search points to dropping it.
Although reduced to a mention, it builds on the established offer and is likely to support other products, so organizational slack permits carrying it while searching for improved use.
